# hallpass_self_approval (Resource)

Whether an agent's owners may approve that agent's requests. Installation-wide: declare it at most once. Destroying it restores the default (prohibited).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hallpass_self_approval" "this" {
  prohibit_self_approval = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `prohibit_self_approval` (Boolean) Refuse approvals by the agent's own owners.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `self-approval`.
